clues: This town is the seat of its county, in the north of its state. It sits at the far north end of a vast metro zone.
Spring storms hit this town hard and oft. Flash floods and fierce thunder storms are a mark of the season here.
This town took its name from a militia chief of the old days. It was made a town in law in the year 1866.
This town is famed for its live music. Its fairs and fests draw more than three hundred thousand guests each year.
Two schools of high learning, set up in 1890 and 1901, set this town apart from all its neighbors round.
